title: Log the empty catch(_) blocks swallowing temp-dir cleanup failures in epic_19_offline_first_test.dart
why: EH-3 bans empty and log-less catches repo-wide. If Directory.delete(recursive: true) fails here — e.g. a held SQLite file handle on the just-closed content/read-only DB — the failure is silently discarded, leaving stray temp dirs with no breadcrumb that cleanup ever failed, exactly the swallowed-exception debugging dead-end EH-3 exists to prevent.
recommendation: At minimum print/log the caught error instead of a bare catch (_) {} in both addTearDown blocks.
acceptance_criteria: grep -n 'catch (_) {}' learning_tracker/test/story_acceptance/epic_19_offline_first_test.dart returns no match, or each site logs the caught error
